description: This file implements auto neighbor addition functionality for a wireless LAN management system. It includes functions to add or delete neighboring access points, manage configuration settings, and handle related network objects.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne s_setNeighbourAP(T_AccessPoint * pAP,T_AccessPoint * targetAP)
methods.description: Adds a specific access point to the neighbor list of a target access point by creating and configuring a neighbor object.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne s_delNeighbourAP(T_AccessPoint * pAP,T_AccessPoint * targetAP)
methods.description: Removes a specific access point from the neighbor list of a target access point by deleting the neighbor object.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_autoNeighAdd_vapSetDelNeighbourAP(T_AccessPoint * pAP,bool set)
methods.description: Enables or disables the addition/removal of neighbor access points for a given access point.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_autoNeighAdd_radioSetDelNeighbourAP(T_Radio * pRad,bool set)
methods.description: Performs neighbor addition/removal procedures for all access points associated with a radio device.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_autoNeighAdd_vapReloadNeighbourAP(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Reloads neighbor access points for a specified access point by removing and then adding neighbors.
